tasks.short: Explain and demonstrate equipment operation and preventive maintenance

steps.what: Read the procedure for preventive maintenance of the medical equipment
Explain correct operation of the medical equipment to personnel
Demonstrate correct operation and preventive maintenance to personnel

tasks.design: She still opens the procedure and reads it, then explains and demonstrates correct operation and preventive maintenance to personnel on the device. No tool is added. Nothing produces a listing, an alert, or a filed training note.
tasks.previous_blocker: The useful part is what this person does with this device in the room, which a procedure text does not show.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the live explanation or the demonstration.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong habit on medical equipment can harm a patient, and only the person in the room can see it.
tasks.human_edge: She sees whether that person can operate the device safely, and she corrects the hands-on try.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in her week on this task. She still explains and demonstrates, and she gains no new decision right.

reach.task: Watch whether staff can operate the device after the demonstration
reach.learn: What correct operation and preventive maintenance look like on this unit

evidence.claim: Showing a person how to operate a medical device is done with that device in the room.
A procedure generator drafts checklists, and those drafts are reviewed before release.
The Dutch hospital medical technology covenant calls for procedures for preventive maintenance by internal and external technicians, and for formal release after every job.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Personnel are staff of the same organisation, so the explanation and the demonstration are internal talk. No version is filed, so neither step is gated.
She still opens and reads the procedure. A listing of procedures would not remove that reading, so none is added.
This task does not draft a checklist and does not file a training note or a formal release. Where a release is required, she still does that later herself, and it is not counted here.
unknowns: Whether the personnel she trains are employed by the same organisation or by a customer site.
research_questions: Does she file any note that the demonstration happened, or is the session only spoken and shown?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still reads the procedure and still explains and demonstrates in the room. No step is shortened, so the low and the high are both a week with no time returned.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Find repair part sources, requisition them, and record receipt

steps.what: Read the work order for the repair parts needed
outputs: part need from the work order

steps.what: Research catalogs and repair part lists to locate sources
inputs: part need from the work order

steps.what: Copy chosen catalogue part number, supplier and price to the requisition
Check the copied requisition lines match the parts she chose
Submit requisitioning of the chosen repair parts
Write their receipt quantities while recording receipt
File receipt v1 for the repair parts received

tasks.design: She still opens the work order and still reads catalogs and repair part lists to choose the source. {PROCUREMENT} then copies part number, supplier and price from the catalogue line she already selected on {PARTNER_PORTAL} onto the requisition draft. It does not produce a listing, does not alert anyone, and does not send an order. She checks the lines, submits requisition v1, and later files receipt v1 herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catalogue names differ from the words on the work order, so a field copy cannot choose the source.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she has selected a catalogue line, part number, supplier and price are fields the purchasing record can copy.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to recognise the right part, and she still has to look at the goods when they arrive.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell a near name from the part that fits the device, and she can see what was actually delivered.
tasks.altitude: She still researches parts and records receipt. She no longer retypes part number, supplier and price after she has chosen the line. The buyer still places any order to the supplier.

reach.task: Place the purchase order after her requisition
reach.learn: The part number, supplier and price she already checked on requisition v1

evidence.claim: A purchasing record can copy part number, supplier and unit price from a catalogue line that already stores those fields.

assumptions: The ten-point share is only the retyping of part number, supplier and price onto the requisition after she has chosen the line. Reading catalogs and repair part lists stays at full remaining time. There is no search-time baseline.

The catalogue line she selects on {PARTNER_PORTAL} holds part number, supplier name and unit price. Producer: that supplier catalogue, selected in the research step. If any of the three fields is missing, the copy does not run and she types the requisition herself.

The work order in {OTHER} (medical equipment maintenance system: work orders and service history) holds the equipment model and the part description she entered on the repair. She still opens and reads it. This task does not list work orders.
The buyer places the external order after requisition v1. That buyer work is outside these steps and is not counted. Nothing here sends to the supplier or raises an alert.
The copy does not log her location or a time stamp. Receipt quantities are what she writes after she sees the goods.
unknowns: Whether the supplier catalogue exposes part number, supplier and unit price as fields a requisition can copy.
Whether the requisition or the receipt stores her location or a time stamp.
research_questions: Which three catalogue fields are present on the line she selects, and who maintains them?

already_counted.description: She checks that the copied part number, supplier and price are the line she chose.

incremental.description: Keep the mapping from the selected catalogue line to the requisition fields.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a week when the selected catalogue line has no part number or price, so she types the requisition and the copy does not run. High is a week when every selected line has part number, supplier and price, after the one-hour mapping upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compute install power and space, then install the unit

steps.what: Measure space for installing related medical dental equipment
inputs: room and supply for the unit

steps.what: Read manufacturers specifications for power and clearance
outputs: power and clearance figures she typed

steps.what: Compute power and space requirements from the entered figures
inputs: power and clearance figures she typed

steps.what: Check computed power and space requirements fit the room
Install units to the manufacturers specifications on site

tasks.design: She still measures the room and still reads the manufacturer specification, and she types the power, clearance and room figures. A calculator drafts the power and space requirements from those figures into the install note on {OTHER}. It does not produce a listing, does not alert the ward, and does not send the figures. She checks that the draft fits the room and the supply, then installs the unit herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each room and each specification differ, and the specification is a document, so the arithmetic was done by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she has typed the room measurements and the manufacturer's power and clearance numbers, the arithmetic is fixed and needs no model.
tasks.still_hard: A tight room or a supply that cannot carry the unit can harm people, and many specifications state the limits only in prose.
tasks.human_edge: She can see whether the unit will actually fit and whether the supply in the room is the one the figures assume.
tasks.altitude: She still measures, reads the specification, and installs. She no longer redoes the power and space arithmetic, and she still accepts or corrects the draft before she installs.

reach.role: electrical and electronics repairer, commercial and industrial equipment
reach.task: Confirm the supply can carry the computed load before the unit is installed
reach.learn: The power figure she accepted and the manufacturer limit it came from

evidence.claim: Once room measurements and the manufacturer's stated power and clearance numbers are known, the power and space arithmetic follows those figures.

assumptions: She types six figures before the calculator runs: room length, room width, room height, supply amps, manufacturer required clearance, and manufacturer power. Producer: the repairer, in the measure step and the specification step. If any figure is missing, the calculator does not run and she computes by hand. Reading and measuring stay at full remaining time.
The twelve-point share is that arithmetic only. It is not a baseline for finding the specification or for the install.

{OTHER} here is the medical equipment maintenance system, used only to hold the draft figures on the install note. The draft is not filed. She does not commit a requirement version, so the calculator step is not gated. She installs only after she accepts the figures.
Nothing lists rooms, alerts the ward, or sends the figures. The install is physical work with no version filed.
unknowns: Whether manufacturer power and clearance are stated as numbers she can type, or only as prose.
Whether her employer requires a filed install calculation before she may fit the unit.
research_questions: Which power and clearance numbers does this manufacturer print, and in what units?

already_counted.description: She checks that the drafted power and space requirements fit the room and the supply.

incremental.description: Keep the calculator that applies the six entered figures, including a change of unit.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a week when the specification states power or clearance only in prose, so she computes by hand and the calculator does not run. High is a week when every install has the six figures as numbers, after the one-hour calculator upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate specifications and identify equipment for possible purchase

steps.what: Read technical specifications and user needs for the equipment
Evaluate which systems are best suited for the intended use
Identify equipment for possible purchase based on requirements
outputs: purchase choice told to the buyer

tasks.design: She still reads the technical specifications and the user needs, decides which equipment or system is suited to the intended use, and tells the buyer. No tool is added. Nothing produces a listing of equipment, an alert, or a purchase order.
tasks.previous_blocker: The choice depends on this use and on specifications that are documents, not a stored score.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new makes the suitability judgement a field copy.
tasks.still_hard: A device that looks suitable on paper can still be wrong for the clinical use, and a wrong purchase is hard to undo.
tasks.human_edge: She can weigh the clinical use against gaps in the specification that no stored field states.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in her week on this task. She still evaluates the specifications and names the equipment, and the buyer still purchases.

reach.task: Decide whether to purchase the equipment she named
reach.learn: The user need and the specification gap behind her choice

evidence.claim: Choosing a medical device for a stated use depends on the specification and on needs that are not a single stored field.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
She still opens and reads the specifications. A listing of equipment would not remove that reading, so none is added.
Telling the buyer is internal talk. No recommendation version is filed, so the step is not gated. She does not send a purchase order. The buyer purchases later, outside this task.
unknowns: Whether she writes a purchase request that stands, or only tells the buyer her choice.
research_questions: Does a written recommendation exist today, and who files it?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still reads the specifications, still decides, and still tells the buyer. No step is shortened, so the low and the high are both a week with no time returned.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still explains, demonstrates, measures, installs, and chooses equipment. On a parts requisition she no longer retypes catalogue fields she has already chosen. On an install she no longer redoes the power and space arithmetic, and she still checks both results.
reach: The buyer places the purchase order after her requisition and needs the part number and price she checked.
A supervisor of mechanics checks that staff can operate a device after her demonstration.
skills_to_grow: Check a calculated power and space result against the room and the supply, not only the arithmetic.
Reject a catalogue line whose name is close but is the wrong part for the device.
role.ambitious_version: She spends catalog time on parts that do not match, and the rest of the week on safe use and safe installs.
